policy.data_scope: meta parents and meta new worlds only
policy.initialization: same development-selected phi and same meta-optimizer state
policy.O4: Merge meta-A history then fit meta-B current, and the reciprocal construction; distinct data sets, persistent FP32 historical masters, ordinary parent fitting charged separately.
policy.parent_retention: task + .25*(.5 language + .5 historical facts); complete binding coverage and initial historical candidate>=.85/EM>=.75; final historical NLL at most initial+.5.
policy.parent_budget: at most six epochs, then at most one true continuation to 512 total updates
policy.phi_clean: O1 from scratch, all q_train=0, same core plus 64x8 specialization schedule as selected mixed phi
